# yanshi

Four skills for falsifiable design decisions, contract-driven E2E evidence, and cross-review handoff. No coding or TDD wrappers.

## Installation

The skills CLI requires Node >= 22.20. With user authorization, install the published suite:

npx skills add Hackerismydream/yanshi --skill '*' -g -a codex

For an extracted or unpublished revision, run from that directory:

npx skills add . --skill '*' -g -a codex

To install only E2E, replace --skill '*' with --skill yanshi-e2e.
The remote command uses the published repository, not an unpublished local package.

For manual installation, follow README.md. Copy complete skill directories to the host's confirmed skill location; for Codex the user location is ~/.agents/skills. Check all destinations first and stop on an existing directory or symlink. Do not overwrite, delete, or merge old installations without authorization.

## Installed names

- yanshi: entry routing; implicit invocation enabled.
- yanshi-challenge: counterexamples, ablation, and simplification; implicit invocation disabled.
- yanshi-e2e: real-interface acceptance and evidence; implicit invocation enabled.
- yanshi-review: cross-review handoff and repair tracking; implicit invocation disabled.

The three specialist skills stand alone. Full entry routing needs all four. Read the selected SKILL.md and its linked files; no dedicated Skill tool is required. Runtime instructions are in Chinese.

## Upgrade from v2

Back up and remove retired installations only with authorization:
yanshi-align, yanshi-design, yanshi-split, yanshi-implement,
yanshi-self-test, yanshi-accept, yanshi-handoff, yanshi-retro.
Replace retained directories completely to avoid stale files. See CHANGELOG.md.

## Verify

Check file presence and host discovery separately. Only yanshi and yanshi-e2e enable implicit invocation in agents/openai.yaml; do not assume another host honors that metadata.

Package check, from the repository root:
python3 scripts/check.py --text-only --self-test

--text-only permits the known image assets to be absent. Omit it in the complete repository. This checks packaging, not model behavior or business outcomes.

## Evidence boundary

Expected results come from the business contract. Success messages do not establish persistence, API evidence does not replace required UI actions, unknown cost is not zero, and retries preserve original failures. No host-behavior improvement has been established.
